method: analytic fixed scenarios; no live playtest or generated-map validation

equipment.assumptions: repeated physical engagements include healing between them; armor reduces healing load, not an automatic win; shield/potion consumable once

exploit_boundaries.energy: cannot voluntarily remove supply if result worsens or causes a deficit; enemy destruction does not disable existing effects
exploit_boundaries.prosperity: current buildings contribute, irreversible tier first award once; one-time costly milestone investment remains allowed
exploit_boundaries.decoy_wall: 1000 gold/30s labor per segment, 20% construction HP; target-nearest rule retained, path lure requires live geometry test
exploit_boundaries.loan: at least three future major-wave stages required; three 12000 repayments at subsequent cycle starts; no terminal free draw
